headline: Rubrik Shares Hit All-Time High at $127.94
summary: Cloud data management and security provider Rubrik saw its stock price reach an all-time high of $127.94.
why: Equity milestones for cloud security providers reflect enterprise software spending trends and market valuation multiples for high-growth tech firms.

impacts.name: Rubrik
impacts.why: Reaching record share prices highlights strong institutional demand and continued valuation multiple expansion.
